@@@ doc empty
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{},"blocks":[]}
@@@ doc small
{"pandoc-api-version":[1,23,1,2],"meta":{"title":{"t":"MetaInlines","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"Probe"}]}},"blocks":[{"t":"Para","c":[{"t":"Str","c":"one"}]}]}
@@@ filter convert-read-asciidoc empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read asciidoc', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc') end)
  probe('read asciidoc-auto_identifiers', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc-auto_identifiers') end)
  probe('read asciidoc+ascii_identifiers', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc+ascii_identifiers') end)
  probe('read asciidoc {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read asciidoc PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('== Head\010\010Some _emphasis_ and *strong*.\010\010* Item\010', 'asciidoc', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  probe('read biblatex {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('@book{example, title={The title}, author={Fam, Giv}, year={2020}}', 'biblatex', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read biblatex {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('@book{example, title={The title}, author={Fam, Giv}, year={2020}}', 'biblatex', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read biblatex {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('@book{example, title={The title}, author={Fam, Giv}, year={2020}}', 'biblatex', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read biblatex {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('@book{example, title={The title}, author={Fam, Giv}, year={2020}}', 'biblatex', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)

@@@ filter convert-read-bits empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)

  local kind = type(value)

  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read bits', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits') end)
  probe('read bits {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read bits {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read bits {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read bits {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read bits {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read bits {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read bits {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read bits {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read bits {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read bits {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read bits PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'bits', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end

local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-dokuwiki empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read dokuwiki', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki') end)
  probe('read dokuwiki-smart', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki-smart') end)
  probe('read dokuwiki+raw_html', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki+raw_html') end)
  probe('read dokuwiki+tex_math_dollars', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki+tex_math_dollars') end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read dokuwiki PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('====== Head ======\010\010Some //emph// and **strong**.\010\010  * item\010', 'dokuwiki', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-fb2 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read fb2', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2') end)
  probe('read fb2 {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read fb2 {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read fb2 PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<FictionBook xmlns="http://www.gribuser.ru/xml/fictionbook/2.0"><body><section><p>Some <emphasis>emphasis</em>.</p></section></body></FictionBook>', 'fb2', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-haddock empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read haddock', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock') end)
  probe('read haddock+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock+east_asian_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read haddock {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read haddock {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read haddock {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read haddock {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read haddock {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read haddock {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read haddock {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read haddock {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read haddock {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read haddock {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read haddock PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('= Head\010\010Some /emphasis/ and __strong__.\010', 'haddock', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read ipynb', function() return P.read('{"nbformat": 4, "nbformat_minor": 5, "metadata": {"language_info": {"name": "python"}}, "cells": [{"id": "intro", "cell_type": "markdown", "metadata": {}, "source": ["# Head\092n", "\092n", "Some *emphasis* and $x^2$."]}, {"id": "code", "cell_type": "code", "metadata": {}, "source": "print(3)", "execution_count": 1, "outputs": [{"output_type": "stream", "name": "stdout", "text": "3\092n"}]}]}', 'ipynb') end)

end

@@@ filter convert-read-jats empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read jats', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats') end)
  probe('read jats {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read jats {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read jats {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read jats {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read jats {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read jats {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read jats {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read jats {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read jats {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read jats {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read jats PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<article><body><sec id="head"><title>Head</title><p>Some <italic>emphasis</italic>.</p></sec></body></article>', 'jats', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read latex', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex') end)
  probe('read latex+raw_tex', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex+raw_tex') end)
  probe('read latex-smart', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex-smart') end)
  probe('read latex-latex_macros', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex-latex_macros') end)
  probe('read latex {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read latex {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read latex {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read latex {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read latex {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read latex {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read latex {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read latex {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)

  probe('read latex PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('\092section{Head}\092label{h}\010Some \092emph{emph} ``q\039\039 -- dash \092foo{x} $a$\010\010\092begin{itemize}\092item one\092end{itemize}\010% comment\010', 'latex', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-man empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read man', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man') end)
  probe('read man-auto_identifiers', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man-auto_identifiers') end)
  probe('read man {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read man {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read man {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read man {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read man {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read man {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read man {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read man {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read man {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read man {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read man PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('.TH SAMPLE 1\010.SH NAME\010Sample \092- example\010.SH DESCRIPTION\010Some \092fIemphasis\092fP.\010', 'man', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-markdown_mmd empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

@@@ filter convert-read-markdown_strict empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read markdown_strict', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict') end)
  probe('read markdown_strict+smart', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict+smart') end)
  probe('read markdown_strict+pipe_tables', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict+pipe_tables') end)
  probe('read markdown_strict+footnotes', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict+footnotes') end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)

  probe('read markdown_strict {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read markdown_strict {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('# A head {#top}\010\010Some *emph*, **strong**, "quotes" -- and --- dashes...\010a_b_c ~~gone~~ <b>raw</b> https://example.org and $x^2$ and Mr. Smith.\010\010    indented code\010\010| a | b |\010|---|---|\010| 1 | 2 |\010\010- [ ] task\010- item[^1]\010\010[^1]: The note.\010\010<!-- hidden -->\010\010![image](picture)\010', 'markdown_strict', {abbreviations = {}}) end)

    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read muse', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse') end)
  probe('read muse+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse+east_asian_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read muse {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read muse {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read muse {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read muse {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)

  probe('read muse {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read muse {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read muse {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some *emphasis* and **strong**.\010', 'muse', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-native empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('read native {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read native {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read native {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('[Header 1 ("h",[],[]) [Str "H"],Para [Emph [Str "a"],Space,Str "b"]]', 'native', {abbreviations = {}}) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-opml empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read opml', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml') end)
  probe('read opml+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml+east_asian_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read opml {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read opml {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read opml {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read opml {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read opml {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read opml {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read opml {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read opml {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read opml {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read opml {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read opml PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<opml version="2.0"><head><title>Sample</title></head><body><outline text="Head" _note="Some *emphasis*."/></body></opml>', 'opml', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-org empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end

    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read org', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some /emph/ and *strong*.\010\010- item\010', 'org') end)
  probe('read org-auto_identifiers', function() return P.read('* Head\010\010Some /emph/ and *strong*.\010\010- item\010', 'org-auto_identifiers') end)

  run(document)

@@@ filter convert-read-pod empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read pod', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod') end)
  probe('read pod+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod+east_asian_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read pod {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read pod {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read pod {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read pod {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read pod {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read pod {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read pod {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read pod {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read pod {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read pod {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read pod PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('=head1 Head\010\010Some I<emphasis> and C<code>.\010\010=cut\010', 'pod', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-ris empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read ris', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris') end)
  probe('read ris {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read ris {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read ris {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read ris {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read ris {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read ris {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read ris {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read ris {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read ris {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read ris {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read ris PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('TY  - BOOK\010ID  - example\010TI  - The title\010AU  - Fam, Giv\010PY  - 2020\010ER  - \010', 'ris', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-rst empty small

local function run(document)
  probe('read rst', function() return P.read('A heading\010=========\010\010Some *emphasis*, **strong text**, and `a link <https://example.org>`__.\010\010::\010\010    sample\010\010.. note::\010\010   A note.\010\010>>> print(1)\010', 'rst') end)
  probe('read rst-auto_identifiers', function() return P.read('A heading\010=========\010\010Some *emphasis*, **strong text**, and `a link <https://example.org>`__.\010\010::\010\010    sample\010\010.. note::\010\010   A note.\010\010>>> print(1)\010', 'rst-auto_identifiers') end)

  probe('read rst {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('A heading\010=========\010\010Some *emphasis*, **strong text**, and `a link <https://example.org>`__.\010\010::\010\010    sample\010\010.. note::\010\010   A note.\010\010>>> print(1)\010', 'rst', {tab_stop = 8}) end)

  probe('read rst {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('A heading\010=========\010\010Some *emphasis*, **strong text**, and `a link <https://example.org>`__.\010\010::\010\010    sample\010\010.. note::\010\010   A note.\010\010>>> print(1)\010', 'rst', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)

@@@ filter convert-read-rtf empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read rtf', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf') end)
  probe('read rtf+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf+east_asian_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read rtf {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read rtf {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read rtf {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read rtf {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read rtf {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read rtf {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read rtf {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read rtf {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read rtf {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read rtf {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read rtf PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('{\092rtf1\092ansi Some {\092i emph} and {\092b strong}.\092par}', 'rtf', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
