function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-read-xml empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('read xml', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml') end)
  probe('read xml+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml+east_asian_line_breaks') end)
  probe('read xml {columns = 20}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {columns = 20}) end)
  probe('read xml {tab_stop = 2}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {tab_stop = 2}) end)
  probe('read xml {tab_stop = 8}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {tab_stop = 8}) end)
  probe('read xml {indented_code_classes = {\039lua\039, \039x\039}}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {indented_code_classes = {'lua', 'x'}}) end)
  probe('read xml {default_image_extension = \039png\039}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {default_image_extension = 'png'}) end)
  probe('read xml {strip_comments = true}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {strip_comments = true}) end)
  probe('read xml {standalone = true}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {standalone = true}) end)
  probe('read xml {abbreviations = {[\039Mr.\039] = true}}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {abbreviations = {['Mr.'] = true}}) end)
  probe('read xml {abbreviations = {}}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {abbreviations = {}}) end)
  probe('read xml {track_changes = \039all-changes\039}', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', {track_changes = 'all-changes'}) end)
  probe('read xml PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS', function() return P.read('<Pandoc><meta/><blocks><Para>Sample <Emph>text</Emph></Para></blocks></Pandoc>', 'xml', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-ansi empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write ansi', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write ansi PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'ansi', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-asciidoctor empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write asciidoctor', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write asciidoctor {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write asciidoctor PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'asciidoctor', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

@@@ filter convert-write-bbcode_fluxbb empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write bbcode_fluxbb', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'bbcode_fluxbb'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write bbcode_fluxbb {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'bbcode_fluxbb', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write bbcode_fluxbb {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'bbcode_fluxbb', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write bbcode_fluxbb {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'bbcode_fluxbb', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write bbcode_fluxbb {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'bbcode_fluxbb', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

@@@ filter convert-write-bbcode_steam empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-beamer empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-biblatex empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write biblatex {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'biblatex', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-bibtex empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)

@@@ filter convert-write-chunkedhtml empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write chunkedhtml', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml'); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml+east_asian_line_breaks', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml+east_asian_line_breaks'); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {columns = 30}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {columns = 30}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {reference_links = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {reference_links = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {setext_headers = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {setext_headers = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {number_sections = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {number_sections = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {section_divs = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {section_divs = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {html_q_tags = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {html_q_tags = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)

  probe('write chunkedhtml {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)
  probe('write chunkedhtml {tab_stop = 2}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'chunkedhtml', {tab_stop = 2}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); assert(bytes:find('index.html', 1, true)); assert(bytes:find('sitemap.json', 1, true)); return true end)

  probe('write commonmark+smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'commonmark+smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-commonmark_x empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-context empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write context', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write context {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write context {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write context {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'context', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-csljson empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

@@@ filter convert-write-djot empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write djot', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write djot PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'djot', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})

@@@ filter convert-write-docbook4 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write docbook4', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write docbook4 {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docbook4', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write docx PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'docx', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'docx').blocks) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-dokuwiki empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

@@@ filter convert-write-dzslides empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write dzslides', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write dzslides {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write dzslides {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write dzslides {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'dzslides', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

local function run(document)
  probe('write epub', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub'); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {columns = 30}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {columns = 30}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {reference_links = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {reference_links = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {setext_headers = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {setext_headers = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {number_sections = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {number_sections = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {section_divs = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {section_divs = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub {html_q_tags = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub', {html_q_tags = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)

@@@ filter convert-write-epub2 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write epub2', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2'); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub2 {columns = 30}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2', {columns = 30}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub2 {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub2 {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub2 {reference_links = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2', {reference_links = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub2 {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
  probe('write epub2 {setext_headers = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, 'epub2', {setext_headers = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 2) == 'PK'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'epub').blocks) end)
