function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-fodt empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function fodt_body(xml)
  local body = assert(xml:match('(<office:body>.-</office:body>)'))
  -- Match equivalent XML text and attribute order. Skip the formula
  -- annotation because Pandoc and Randoc use different encodings (I-ODT-03).
  body = body:gsub('>([^<]+)<', function(text)
    return '>' .. text:gsub('&quot;', '"') .. '<'
  end)
  body = body:gsub('(<math) (display="[^"]+") (xmlns="[^"]+")>', '%1 %3 %2>')
  return (body:gsub('<annotation encoding="StarMath 5%.0">.-</annotation>', '')
              :gsub('<annotation encoding="application/x%-tex">.-</annotation>', ''))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-gfm empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write gfm', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write gfm-pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'gfm-pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

@@@ filter convert-write-haddock empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write haddock', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write haddock PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'haddock', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-html4 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-html5 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

@@@ filter convert-write-icml empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write icml', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write icml {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write icml {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'icml', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

@@@ filter convert-write-jats_publishing empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write jats_publishing', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write jats_publishing {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'jats_publishing', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-json empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-latex empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)

  probe('write latex-smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex-smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write latex+raw_tex', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'latex+raw_tex'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-man empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write markdown-smart', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown-smart'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_github empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_mmd empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write markdown_mmd', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_mmd-pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_mmd-pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_phpextra empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markdown_strict empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write markdown_strict+pipe_tables', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict+pipe_tables'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write markdown_strict+footnotes', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'markdown_strict+footnotes'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-markua empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-mediawiki empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-ms empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-muse empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write muse+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'muse+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write muse {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'muse', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write muse {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'muse', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write muse {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'muse', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write muse PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'muse', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-native empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-odt empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function odt_content(bytes)
  local ok, archive = pcall(function() return P.zip.Archive(bytes) end)
  if not ok then
    if archive ~= 'pandoc.zip.Archive is not implemented in Randoc' then error(archive, 0) end
    return P.read(bytes, 'odtcontentxml').blocks[1].text
  end
  for _, entry in ipairs(archive.entries) do
    if entry.path == 'content.xml' then return entry:contents() end
  end
  error('Missing content.xml')
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-opendocument empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write opendocument', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'opendocument'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
