@@@ filter convert-write-opml empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write opml', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write opml PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'opml', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-plain empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-pptx empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write pptx', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx'); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx+east_asian_line_breaks', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx+east_asian_line_breaks'); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {columns = 30}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {columns = 30}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {reference_links = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {reference_links = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {setext_headers = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {setext_headers = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {number_sections = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {number_sections = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {section_divs = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {section_divs = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {html_q_tags = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {html_q_tags = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)

  probe('write pptx {list_tables = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {list_tables = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {table_of_contents = true}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {table_of_contents = true}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {number_offset = {3, 1}}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx {dpi = 300}', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', {dpi = 300}); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
  probe('write pptx PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() local bytes = P.write(P.Pandoc{H(1, 'Head'), P.Para{P.Str'Sample'}}, 'pptx', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS); assert(bytes:sub(1, 4) == 'PK\003\004'); return P.Pandoc(P.read(bytes, 'pptx').blocks) end)
end

  run(document)

@@@ filter convert-write-revealjs empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-rtf empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

  probe('write rtf {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head one', P.Attr('top')), P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"', P.Space(), P.Link('link', 'https://example.org', 'T'), P.Space(), P.Link('mail', 'mailto:me@example.org'), P.Space(), P.Code('c'), P.Space(), P.Note{P.Para'note'}, P.Space(), P.Math('InlineMath', 'x^2'), P.Space(), P.Quoted('DoubleQuote', 'qq'), P.Space(), P.Strikeout's', P.Space(), P.Str'a long line of words that the writer wraps at the column limit of the options'}, H(2, 'Head two'), P.BulletList{{P.Plain'one'}, {P.Plain'two'}}, P.CodeBlock('code', P.Attr('', {'nolang'})), P.HorizontalRule(), P.Div(P.Para'in div', P.Attr('d', {'c'})), P.Table(P.Caption{P.Plain'cap'}, {{P.AlignDefault, P.ColWidthDefault}}, P.TableHead{}, {{attr = P.Attr(), body = {P.Row{P.Cell'cell'}}, head = {}, row_head_columns = 0}}, P.TableFoot{})}, {title = P.Inlines'The title', references = {{id = 'k', type = 'book', title = 'T'}}}), 'rtf', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  run(document)

@@@ filter convert-write-s5 empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write s5', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write s5 {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write s5 {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 's5', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-slidy empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write slidy', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write slidy {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write slidy {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write slidy {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Part', P.Attr('part')), H(2, 'Slide', P.Attr('slide')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}, P.BulletList{{P.Plain'first'}, {P.Plain'second'}}, H(2, 'End')}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'slidy', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))

@@@ filter convert-write-tei empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write tei', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write tei {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write tei {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write tei {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'tei', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

@@@ filter convert-write-textile empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write textile', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write textile {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

  probe('write textile {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write textile {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'textile', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-write-vimdoc empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write vimdoc', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'vimdoc'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write vimdoc+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'vimdoc+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write vimdoc {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'vimdoc', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write vimdoc {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'vimdoc', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write vimdoc {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'vimdoc', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)

@@@ filter convert-write-xml empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('write xml', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml+east_asian_line_breaks', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml+east_asian_line_breaks'):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {columns = 30}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {columns = 30}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {wrap_text = \039wrap-none\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-none'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {wrap_text = \039wrap-preserve\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {wrap_text = 'wrap-preserve'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {reference_links = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {reference_links = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {reference_location = \039end-of-section\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {reference_location = 'end-of-section'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {setext_headers = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {setext_headers = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {number_sections = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {number_sections = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {section_divs = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {section_divs = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {identifier_prefix = \039p-\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {identifier_prefix = 'p-'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {html_q_tags = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {html_q_tags = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {email_obfuscation = \039references\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {email_obfuscation = 'references'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {top_level_division = \039top-level-chapter\039}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {top_level_division = 'top-level-chapter'}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {tab_stop = 2}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {tab_stop = 2}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {prefer_ascii = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {prefer_ascii = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {slide_level = 1}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {slide_level = 1}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {incremental = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {incremental = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {list_tables = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {list_tables = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {table_of_contents = true}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {table_of_contents = true}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {number_offset = {3, 1}}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {number_offset = {3, 1}}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml {dpi = 300}', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', {dpi = 300}):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
  probe('write xml PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS', function() return (P.write(P.Pandoc({H(1, 'Head', P.Attr('head')), P.Para{P.Str'Sample', P.Space(), P.Emph'text'}}, {title = P.Inlines'Sample'}), 'xml', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS):gsub('\n+$', '')) end)
end

  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})

@@@ filter convert-write-zimwiki empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end

@@@ filter convert-arguments empty small

local P = pandoc
local log = {}
local function t(s) return P.Str(s) end
local function H(level, text, attr) return P.Header(level, {t(text)}, attr or P.Attr()) end
local function cell(text) return P.Cell{P.Plain{t(text)}} end
local function show(value, depth)
  depth = depth or 0
  local kind = type(value)
  -- Not `%q`: its escapes depend on the C locale (row I-LUA-13).
  if kind == 'string' then
    return '"' .. value:gsub('[\0-\31\127"\\]', function(c) return '\\' .. c:byte() end) .. '"'
  end
  if kind == 'number' then return math.type(value) .. ':' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'table' and depth < 6 then
    local mt = getmetatable(value)
    local name = mt and rawget(mt, '__name')
    if name == 'Inlines' or name == 'Blocks' then return name .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
    local keys = {}
    for key in pairs(value) do keys[#keys + 1] = key end
    table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end)
    local parts = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
      parts[#parts + 1] = show(key, depth + 1) .. '=' .. show(value[key], depth + 1)
    end
    return (name and (tostring(name) .. ' ') or '') .. '{' .. table.concat(parts, ', ') .. '}'
  end
  if kind == 'userdata' then return P.utils.type(value) .. ' ' .. tostring(value) end
  if kind == 'function' then return 'function' end
  return tostring(value)
end
local function probe(label, fn)
  local results = table.pack(pcall(fn))
  local parts = {}
  for i = 2, results.n do parts[#parts + 1] = show(results[i]) end
  -- Pandoc raises some errors as `PandocError` objects (row I-LUA-10):
  -- the text of an error is compared, not its type.
  if not results[1] then parts = {show(tostring(results[2]))} end
  local line = label .. (results[1] and ' => ' or ' !! ') .. table.concat(parts, ' | ')
  -- Addresses differ from run to run.
  log[#log + 1] = (line:gsub('0x%x%x%x%x+', 'ADDR'))
end

local function run(document)
  probe('readers type', function() return type(P.readers), P.readers.markdown, P.readers.native end)
  probe('writers type', function() return type(P.writers), P.writers.html, P.writers.native end)
  probe('read native document', function() return P.read('Pandoc (Meta {unMeta = fromList []}) [Plain [Str "b"]]', 'native') end)
  probe('read native error', function() return P.read('[Para [Str "a"]', 'native') end)
  probe('read native words', function() return P.read('[a](b)', 'native') end)
  probe('read default format', function() return P.read('*a* "b"') end)
  probe('read number', function() return P.read(12, 'native') end)
  probe('read number markdown', function() return P.read(1.5) end)
  probe('read list', function() return P.read({'[Para [Str "a"]', ']'}, 'native') end)
  probe('read list markdown', function() return P.read({'*a', 'b*'}) end)
  probe('read empty list', function() return P.read({}, 'native') end)
  probe('read list latex', function() return P.read({'\\emph{a', 'b}'}, 'latex') end)
  probe('read list html', function() return P.read({'<em>a', 'b</em>'}, 'html') end)
  probe('read list line ends', function() return P.read({'a\n', '\nb'}) end)
  probe('read list heading', function() return P.read({'# a', 'b'}, 'commonmark') end)
  probe('read list number item', function() return P.read({'a', 5}) end)
  probe('read list table item', function() return P.read({'a', {}}) end)
  probe('read list boolean item', function() return P.read({true}, 'native') end)
  probe('read spec table extensions string', function() return P.read('"a"', {format = 'markdown', extensions = 'smart'}) end)
  probe('read spec table extensions number list', function() return P.read('"a"', {format = 'markdown', extensions = {5}}) end)
  probe('read spec table extensions unknown map', function() return P.read('"a"', {format = 'markdown', extensions = {nosuch = false}}) end)
  probe('read spec table extensions unsupported map', function() return P.read('[]', {format = 'native', extensions = {smart = false}}) end)
  probe('read invalid utf8', function() return P.read('\255', 'native') end)
  probe('read invalid utf8 later', function() return P.read('[Para [Str "\195\40"]]', 'native') end)
  probe('read nil', function() return P.read(nil) end)
  probe('read boolean', function() return P.read(true, 'native') end)
  probe('read no argument', function() return P.read() end)
  probe('read unknown', function() return P.read('x', 'nosuch') end)
  probe('read writer name', function() return P.read('x', 'plain') end)
  probe('read upper', function() return P.read('[]', 'NATIVE') end)
  probe('read upper extension', function() return P.read('"a"', 'Markdown-Smart') end)
  probe('read spec plus', function() return P.read('x', '+smart') end)
  probe('read spec empty', function() return P.read('x', '') end)
  probe('read spec minus', function() return P.read('x', '-x') end)
  probe('read bad extension', function() return P.read('x', 'markdown+nosuch') end)
  probe('read unsupported extension', function() return P.read('x', 'native+smart') end)
  probe('read empty extension', function() return P.read('x', 'markdown++smart') end)
  probe('read spec space', function() return P.read('x', 'mark down') end)
  probe('read spec number', function() return P.read('x', 12) end)
  probe('read spec table', function() return P.read('[]', {format = 'native'}) end)
  probe('read spec table markdown list', function() return P.read('"a" ~~b~~', {format = 'markdown', extensions = {'strikeout'}}) end)
  probe('read spec table markdown map', function() return P.read('"a" ~~b~~', {format = 'markdown', extensions = {smart = false, strikeout = 'enable'}}) end)
  probe('read spec table markdown map disable', function() return P.read('"a" ~~b~~', {format = 'markdown', extensions = {strikeout = 'disable'}}) end)
  probe('read spec table no format', function() return P.read('[]', {}) end)
  probe('read spec table number', function() return P.read('[]', {format = 1}) end)
  probe('read spec table bad list', function() return P.read('[]', {format = 'native', extensions = {'nosuch'}}) end)
  probe('read spec table bad map', function() return P.read('[]', {format = 'native', extensions = {smart = true}}) end)
  probe('read options several', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {columns = 3, standalone = true, tab_stop = '2'}) end)
  probe('read options unknown', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {nosuch = 3}) end)
  probe('read options number', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', 5) end)
  probe('read options string', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', 'x') end)
  probe('read options columns', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {columns = 'x'}) end)
  probe('read options tab', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {tab_stop = {}}) end)
  probe('read options classes', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {indented_code_classes = 'x'}) end)
  probe('read options abbreviations', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {abbreviations = 'x'}) end)
  probe('read options track', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {track_changes = 'bad'}) end)
  probe('read options key', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', {[1] = 2}) end)
  probe('read options extensions', function() return P.read('"a"', 'markdown', {extensions = {'smart'}}) end)
  probe('read options object changed', function() PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS.columns = 4 return P.read('[]', 'native', PANDOC_READER_OPTIONS) end)
  probe('read env', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', nil, {}) end)
  probe('read env number', function() return P.read('[]', 'native', nil, 5) end)
  probe('write default format', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}) end)
  probe('write native columns text', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'native', {columns = '12'}) end)
  probe('write options object changed', function() PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS.columns = 4 local r = P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'native', PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS) PANDOC_WRITER_OPTIONS.columns = 72 return r end)
  probe('write spec table', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, {format = 'native'}) end)
  probe('write spec table html map', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, {format = 'html', extensions = {smart = false}}) end)
  probe('write spec table markdown list', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, {format = 'markdown', extensions = {'smart'}}) end)
  probe('write unknown', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'nosuch') end)
  probe('write reader name', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'pod') end)
  probe('write upper', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'HTML') end)
  probe('write string', function() return P.write('x') end)
  probe('write block', function() return P.write(P.Para'x', 'native') end)
  probe('write inlines', function() return P.write(P.Inlines'x', 'native') end)
  probe('write table', function() return P.write({}, 'native') end)
  probe('write nothing', function() return P.write() end)
  probe('write bad extension', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'html+nosuch') end)
  probe('write unsupported extension', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'native+smart') end)
  probe('write spec plus', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, '+smart') end)
  probe('write spec empty', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, '') end)
  probe('write spec number', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 7) end)
  probe('write spec table no format', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, {extensions = {}}) end)
  probe('write spec table number', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, {format = 1}) end)
  probe('write options number', function() return P.write(P.Pandoc{P.Para{P.Emph't', P.Space(), P.Str'"q"'}, P.Header(2, 'h')}, 'native', 7) end)

function Pandoc(document)
  run(document)
  return P.Pandoc({P.CodeBlock(table.concat(log, '\n'))})
end
